name: Crewman
description: Every ship needs hands. Yours will do.
long_description: Unrated, unassigned, and mopping something in the cargo bay. Every legend in the black started as a Crewman; most of the corpses did too. Pick a Profession - Marine, Technician, Medtech, Recon or Scientist - and master it to rate for the specialist billets. Master any of them and the Captain's chair stops being furniture and starts being a possibility.
